Title: M01-US02: Clicking Men Opens Men's Fashion Page with Exactly 16 Product Listings
Folder Path: M01 - AI Generated FashionStack Test Cases
Description:
Verifies that clicking the 'Men' link on the FashionStack homepage
navigates to a page with the heading exactly reading 'Men's Fashion',
that the inventory summary states '16 products', and that exactly 16
product cards are displayed on the page.
Preconditions:
1.  The FashionStack homepage is loaded in a supported browser.
2.  The browser is in a clean session with no simulated failures.
3.  The 'Men' navigation link is visible on the homepage.
4.  All product data for the Men's category is available (no simulated
    missing inventory).
Steps: Open the FashionStack homepage in a supported browser.
Expected Result:
The homepage loads successfully. The main navigation is visible,
including a 'Men' link.
